family_title_en: Spell the long e word: ee, ea

stages.ix_title: Spell the long e word: ee, ea

what_to_do.en: Tap the right ee or ea spelling.
what_to_do.ko: 알맞은 ee 또는 ea 철자를 누르세요.

stages.choice_rule: Four unique whole-word spellings of one long e word. Exactly one uses the correct ee or ea team. The other three misspell that same word by swapping ee and ea, dropping one letter, or adding one letter. Vary answer_index. Never print the correct spelling in the stem.

gold_items.stem: We sit under this big plant.
A farm animal with soft wool.
When you close your eyes in bed.
The small green part of a plant.
A time like summer or winter.
<NAME> ate a small cake with honey.
The big water where a whale can swim.

roots: Give four whole-word spellings of the same long e word, and make exactly one of them correct.
Wrong choices swap ee with ea, drop one letter, or add one letter. Do not spell a different word except the tier 3 pairs sweet and sweat or sea and see.
Tier 1 wrong choices are easy to see. Tier 2 includes the other vowel team. Tier 3 choices are one letter away.
The right answer must be a long e word spelled with ee or ea. Never accept bread, head, heavy, or sweat as the right answer.
Do not put the correct spelling in the stem. The stem is a short kid-world meaning clue about school, home, food, pets, play, family, or weather.
Use whole words only. No isolated sounds, no sound symbols, and no invented audio file names.

tier_rules.1: Short clues of about five or six words for a common one-syllable long e word. Wrong spellings drop letters or use a clearly wrong vowel, so the right word is easy to see.
tier_rules.2: Grade-level clues of about six to eight words. Include a two-syllable target. One wrong choice swaps ee and ea, and the others drop or add one letter.
tier_rules.3: Longer clues up to ten words with near-miss spellings. Wrong choices are one letter away and may be a real word with the other team, such as sweet and sweat or sea and see.

ee_team.en: This long e word uses the letters ee together.
ee_team.ko: 이 긴 e 단어는 ee를 붙여 씁니다.

ea_team.en: This long e word uses the letters ea together.
ea_team.ko: 이 긴 e 단어는 ea를 붙여 씁니다.

ee_not_ea.en: Use ee here. An ea spelling makes a different word.
ee_not_ea.ko: 여기는 ee를 씁니다. ea로 쓰면 다른 단어가 됩니다.

ea_not_ee.en: Use ea here. An ee spelling makes a different word.
